transcript_text: Customer: We are evaluating your platform for a midmarket rollout, and the primary blocker is integration effort with our current CRM and reporting stack. Agent: We can support phased integration and provide a technical map, including API checkpoints and sandbox validation in week one. Customer: Pricing is still an issue because procurement wants predictable cost bands and no hidden implementation line items. Agent: We can provide a transparent pricing matrix, implementation assumptions, and a scoped rollout option for your first business unit. Customer: Security and compliance reviews are running in parallel, and the internal team worries about audit evidence and change logging. Agent: We provide policy mappings, access logs, and a review pack that can be used directly in your internal compliance workflow. Customer: Another concern is resources because the operations team is already overloaded this quarter. Agent: We can split onboarding into smaller milestones and assign owners so your team can move without a full internal reorganization. Customer: If the rollout plan is realistic and procurement is comfortable, we can schedule a technical deep dive next week. Agent: Great, I will send a concise next-step plan with stakeholders, timeline, and expected deliverables by tomorrow morning. Customer: Please include reporting requirements and a clear summary for legal and procurement. Agent: Understood, I will include reporting, compliance notes, and a draft approval checklist for your review.
